subject: Initial discovery: align AE + SE + Eng + Procurement windows
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reyes <samantha.reyes@luminahc.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Initial discovery: align AE + SE + Eng + Procurement windows

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier this week. We'd love to schedule a 45–60min discovery to bring our SE and engineering counterpart into the conversation so we can:

- Understand LuminaHealth's primary inference SLAs and latency expectations
- Surface security/compliance constraints up front (data residency, SOC 2, audit logs)
- Walk through a rough architecture map so SE can recommend hosting + resource footprint

Availability from our side: Mon/Tue next week (Jul 14–15) between 10:00–14:00 PT, or Thursday Jul 17 after 13:00 PT.

Can you confirm who from your side should be at the table (champion, engineering lead, procurement contact)? Also, if procurement/security need any pre-call evidence (SOC2, DPA, IP addendum), let me know and we can attach the summary.

Proposed agenda attached (light).

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0112

Attachment: Proposed_Agenda_FirstCall.docx (agenda, 1 page)

From: Samantha Reyes <samantha.reyes@luminahc.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@luminahc.com>, procurement@luminahc.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: align AE + SE + Eng + Procurement windows

Thanks Ben —

I can be the champion and will invite Ravi (engineering lead). I'm looping procurement on this thread — their availability is a little narrower. Procurement also asked whether you can provide a one-page SOC 2 summary and a draft DPA ahead of the call so they can triage.

Our internal preference: Tue Jul 15, 11:00–12:00 PT. If that won't work, Ravi suggested Wed Jul 16 late afternoon.

—Samantha
Head of ML Programs | LuminaHealth
samantha.reyes@luminahc.com | (617) 555-9087

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Samantha Reyes <samantha.reyes@luminahc.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: align AE + SE + Eng + Procurement windows

Thanks Samantha — happy to join.

Ben, I can take the SE slot for the call and cover the architecture/ops questions. I'll attach a short SOC 2 summary and a checklist of typical evidence customers ask for. Olga (solutions eng) will drive the initial infra questions and run through sample latency profiles.

Attaching: Lumina_SOC2_Summary_2024.pdf (redacted summary)

If procurement wants a DPA template, we typically share a draft and then our legal team coordinates edits post-call.

Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

Attachment: Lumina_SOC2_Summary_2024.pdf (pdf, 72KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reyes <samantha.reyes@luminahc.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, procurement@luminahc.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: align AE + SE + Eng + Procurement windows

Great — thanks Mina and Samantha.

Samantha, I'm going to tentatively book Tue Jul 15, 11:00–12:00 PT on everyone's calendars and send a calendar invite with the agenda and a calendar link. If procurement can't make that slot we'll pivot to Ravi's Wed Jul 16 suggestion.

One quick ask for the agenda: can Ravi and/or engineering bring one sample prompt/profile (token lengths, typical concurrency estimate) so Mina/Olga can call out recommended model family and warm-up strategy? That helps keep the call concrete.

I'll send the invite now.

—Ben

From: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@luminahc.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Samantha Reyes <samantha.reyes@luminahc.com>
Cc: procurement@luminahc.com, Security Team <security@luminahc.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: align AE + SE + Eng + Procurement windows

Thanks for including me. Tue Jul 15 at 11:00 conflicts with an executive planning review — would you be able to move to Wed Jul 16, 16:00–17:00 PT? Procurement also flagged that they'd like a short pre-call packet (SOC2 summary + token/traffic estimate) so they can validate budget headroom.

On the packet: I'll share a short example prompt set in a follow-up email this morning.

—Ravi
Engineering Lead | LuminaHealth
ravi.patel@luminahc.com

Appreciate the heads up Ravi — moving to Wed Jul 16, 16:00–17:00 PT works for us.

I've updated the agenda and sent a calendar invite (link below). Mina and Olga will lead the tech portion; I'll cover timelines/pricing anchors and handoff to procurement after the call. Attached again: SOC2 summary + agenda.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
Attachments: Lumina_SOC2_Summary_2024.pdf, Proposed_Agenda_FirstCall.docx

If procurement needs a DPA draft before legal review, let me know and I'll ask our legal team to prioritize a draft.

See you on Wed.
—Ben
